draft.emotion: warm and welcoming, glad to have someone over
notes: Can mean both the visitor (guest) and the person receiving them (host), though 'guest' is much more common.
Same form for masculine and feminine (plural: gli ospiti / le ospiti); in the singular, 'un ospite' is masculine and 'un'ospite' (with an apostrophe) is feminine.
